message.content:
VOTE: APPROVE

Reservations for the record:

1. The matched-comparator claim rests entirely on the code asserting identical snapshot/R/eligibility. I want that identity test executed before the November row, not merely stated. If it ever fails, the shadow row must be logged missing with a reason, and no backfill may repair it.

2. Canonical serialization must be frozen and tested — key sorting, fixed float formatting, nonce generation, line reconstruction — before sealing. An unhashable first row cannot be retroactively committed.

3. The β₂ identification disclosure (six zero-labelled inversion rows, curve ≈ curve_min12, no post-inversion origins) should print alongside the fitted coefficients at every September refit, not only at sealing. Otherwise a later reader will over-read the shadow.

We need answer as DeepSeek V4 Pro. We need decide approve/reject consensus text Round 4. We have our previous positions. We need see if consensus draft incorporates. It seems yes: hash commitment, H=12 pre-existence, no scored bar, November start, live min published monthly, no public probability. Need scrutinize. We can approve with reservations maybe. Need ensure first line exactly 'VOTE: APPROVE' or 'VOTE: REJECT'. If approve up to 3 reservations. We are one of council. Need be concrete, no filler. About 350 words max.

Need evaluate consensus draft against our positions:

Our D1: yes shadow, matched control? Compromise accept single two-feature without matched control if spec states operational P confounds memory with refit timing. Does consensus draft state that? It says operational P is matched comparator because same fit vintage, no separate control. Actually they addressed: "The operational P is therefore the matched curve-only comparator; no separate control." In our previous position we accepted single two-feature shadow without matched control if spec states operational P confounds memory with refit timing. But now consensus says operational P is matched comparator due to identical vintage, which was fact-check. We earlier accepted Argon's fact-check? Our position says secretary framing accurate. We hadn't explicitly accepted operational P matched after fact-check? Our Round 3 position: "Yes: one committed fitted shadow forecast, plus one matched curve-only control fitted on the identical snapshot/R/eligibility. ... Compromise: I accept the single two-feature shadow without the matched control if the control is deemed too much apparatus, but then the spec must state that operational P confounds memory with refit timing." But later the fact-check by secretary maybe operational P is exact matched control. We in previous round did not explicitly adjust. Need decide if approve. The consensus says operational P is matched comparator. That is consistent and obviates separate control. So okay.

D2: hash commitment: yes.

D3: no scored bar, descriptive tracking. Consensus has no scored bar. okay.

D4: pre-existence only; consensus: pre-existence only, label equality mnemonic, E2 disclosed. okay.

D5: reject extra fit; consensus no extra fit, discloses. okay.

D6: live value published monthly; consensus says last 12 published monthly values, no trailing daily. okay.

D7: November. okay.

So likely APPROVE with reservations. Need formulate up to 3 reservations. Must not block. Need maybe note one concern: 2.3 says curve column at live input = operational live curve, memory uses published monthly. Fine.

Potential reservations:
1. The "matched comparator" language is acceptable only because fit identity is asserted in code; if identity fails, no comparator exists—spec must fail loudly. It says assert loudly. Maybe okay.
2. Hash commitment canonical serialization must include nonce and fixed float formatting; already says. Could mention ensure canonicalization tested pre-November, because if spec sealed but code not tested, first row can be missing. Not a blocker.
3. The shadow's fitted β₂ likely unidentifiable due to collinearity on inversion-period zeros; the spec discloses this, but I want the disclosure not buried. Already 2.5.

Need fit word limit. First line exactly. Then maybe 3 bullet reservations. Write as DeepSeek V4 Pro.

Need ensure no hedging boilerplate? We can be direct. Approve.
